argv:
from pathlib import Path; import sys,subprocess; s=Path("src/CMDRRRepeat.lean").read_text(); a=s.index(" theorem row_twoCycle_single"); b=s.index(" := by",a); c=s.index("  apply h.repeated_women_single hf",b); header="""import CMDRRRowDegree

namespace CMDRR
variable {M W O : Type} [Fintype O]
namespace Source
variable {s : Matching M W} {d : Schedule M W O} (h : Source s d)
theorem row_twoCycle_games (x y : Cell s) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : h.U x = y) (hy : h.U y = x) :
    ∃ o p : O, o ≠ p ∧ (d.game o).Women x.1.2 y.1.2 ∧
      (d.game p).Women x.1.2 y.1.2 ∧
      (∃ w, (d.game o).Partners x.1.1 w) ∧
      (∃ w, (d.game p).Partners x.1.1 w) := by
"""; proof=s[b+len(" := by\n"):c]; end="""  refine ⟨a.1,b.1,hab,hoa,hob,⟨a.2.1.2,a.2.2⟩,b.2.1.2,?_⟩
  rw [hm]
  exact b.2.2
end Source

 theorem count_two_exhaust (p : O → Prop) (hc : count p = 2)
    {a b : O} (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : p a) (hb : p b) :
    ∀ o, p o → o = a ∨ o = b := by
  classical
  let S := Finset.univ.filter p
  have hs : S.card = 2 := hc
  have he : ({a,b} : Finset O) = S := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> simp [S,ha,hb]
    · simp [hs,hab]
  intro o ho
  have hh : o ∈ S := by simp [S,ho]
  rw [← he] at hh
  simpa using hh
end CMDRR
"""; subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","write_lane.py","src/CMDRRIncidence.lean"],input=header+proof+end,text=True,check=True)
